text:
jess: Heads-up — we're planning a breaking request/response envelope change for partner SDKs next quarter. Root: change batching payload from `inputs: [ ... ]` to `payloads: { items: [...], meta: {...} }`. Need partner alignment for marketplace/hw/SI. ETA: 2026-06-01 for beta.

omar: Ack. Can you share compatibility window/rollback plan?

jess: Timeline: beta week on 2026-06-01, 30-day optional opt-in, forced switch 2026-07-01. Rollback: gateway will accept both envelopes for 90 days, but SDKs must migrate. We'll offer shims.

linh: Are we including streaming changes? That affects HW partners with low-memory runtimes.

jess: Streaming unchanged for now — only batch RPC payload. We'll add a flag `X-Redwood-Payload-Variant: v2`.

marco: @jess, partners will need test harnesses and telemetry. Can eng-ml produce sample datasets and a validation script?

sasha: Product note: update marketplace listing and docs. Legal: need notice text for contracts.

jess: Agreed. Draft plan: 1) partner notification + embargo 2) test harness (docker image + curl tests) 3) telemetry gating 4) SDK shims and migration guide 5) announcement and helpdesk cadence.

partner_ops_bot: Created issue RW-PLAT-5421: partner compatibility playbook (link: https://rwd/issues/5421)

omar: For partner comms, recommend: partner-specific rollout windows (SI vs marketplace vendors) and a hotfix escrow clause. We should propose a 2-week canary with 3 major partners.

linh: I'll scope the validation script. Need clarity on sample payload shape — jess can you paste example?

jess: sure:
```
POST /v1/requests
Headers: X-Redwood-Payload-Variant: v2
Body:
{
  "payloads": {
    "items": [ { "id": "p1", "text": "..." } ],
    "meta": { "batch_id": "b-123", "origin": "partner-x" }
  }
}
```

marco: We'll add a metric `partner.payload_migration.v2_pct` and an alert if error rate > 1% during canary.

sasha: Do we need translations/locale impacts for SI partners? Some send locale per-item.

jess: `meta` allows per-item overrides; add `locale` inside each item.

omar: Ok. Next steps: Jess to draft partner comms + timeline by EOD Friday. Linh + Marco to produce test harness by next Wed. Sasha to prepare marketplace docs and contact legal. I'll coordinate canary partner list.

sasha: noted. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks everyone — adding owners to RW-PLAT-5421. Ping me if blockers.
